inlines.v: LO'CATE, verb transitive [Latin loco, locatus.] 1. To place; to set in a particular spot or position. 2. To select, survey and settle the bounds of a particular tract of land; or to designate a portion of land by limits; as, to locate a tract of a hundred acres in a particular township. 3. To designate and determine the place of; as, a committee was appointed to locate a church or a court house.
